dialogues.speaker: Kukkia
dialogues.text: O Moon Goddess, may you guard the path ahead of us...

dialogues.speaker: Kukkia
dialogues.text: ...Phew. Next up, time to clean the area around the statue.

dialogues.speaker: Kukkia
dialogues.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME}. Thanks for your kindness, but I'll handle this myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kukkia
dialogues.text: I will always tidy up my surroundings following prayer. It's become a habit of mine at this point.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do the others do this as well?

dialogues.speaker: Kukkia
dialogues.text: I don't pay their actions too much mind, but I'm sure they all do the same.

dialogues.speaker: Kukkia
dialogues.text: After all, ensuring that our goddess's statue is clean is an act equivalent to prayer.

dialogues.speaker: Kukkia
dialogues.text: #I still have some flowers here. Would you like to pray alongside me, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Kukkia
response.text: Alright. Close your eyes, then. I'll lead with the words.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You join Kukkia for a session of earnest prayer.

response.speaker: Kukkia
response.text: #That should do. I'm sure that the Moon Goddess will hear you, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Kukkia
response.text: May the Moon Goddess guard your path.

choices.text: I haven't too much time at the moment...

response.speaker: Kukkia
response.text: That's quite alright. Just come by if you wish to pray. The Moon Goddess shall surely hear you.
